title: Git
loadError: Could not read this folder's changes. Make sure the folder is still there, then try again.
notInitialized: Connect git and changes start piling up
notInitializedHint: This folder is already open as a map. Connect git and every edit leaves a trace you can read: and roll back to.
neverSent: This branch was never sent to origin
sendBranchHint: Sends {branch} to origin for the first time. From then on, Push and Pull follow origin/{branch}. Only when you press it.
detachedHead: A commit is checked out, not a branch. Sending needs a branch.
upstreamUnknown: No destination set for this branch
pushOptInHint: Sends to {upstream}: only when you press it.
pushNoUpstream: Right now this only stacks up on this computer: tell us an address and you can send it.
pushOptInFirstHint: Sends to origin: {branch} goes there for the first time and follows it from then on. Only when you press it.
pushDetachedHint: A commit is checked out, not a branch, so nothing can be sent.
pushFailed: Couldn't reach {remote}. Your {count} saved step(s) are still on this computer.
stagedOutsideNotice: {count} change(s) staged outside this folder are left alone.
diffEmpty: This is a new document, so there's nothing earlier to compare.
webNoChanges: Nothing yet. Edit a document and it shows up here.
webDesktopHint: A browser isn't allowed to run git on this computer. What changed is still shown here.
scopeNotice: Only documents inside this folder are recorded. Files outside it are left alone.
initWhatHappens: Starting adds one bookkeeping folder (.git) inside this folder. Your documents stay as they are, and the history lives only on this computer.
initEscape: To undo this, delete the .git folder that was just created. Your documents stay.
noChangesHint: This folder matches your last step. Edit a document and it shows up here.
remoteSetupBody: To read this on another machine or keep a backup, tell us the remote repository (GitHub, GitLab, …) once. We only send to that address, and only when you click.
remoteHelp: You can copy the URL from the Code button on the GitHub/GitLab repository page.
remoteFailedSafe: Your saved steps are still on this computer.
historyEmptyHint: Edit a document, then save your first step on the left.

install.title: git isn't on this computer
install.body: git is the program that keeps your change history. Install it once and everything else happens on this screen.
install.xcode: Install command line tools (recommended: Apple's built-in path)
install.winget: Install with winget (recommended: built into Windows)

stepAppNote: Reading a folder on this computer needs the app
stepFolderNote: Pick one markdown folder to keep
previewCaption: Once you're connected, this is what fills the screen
noVaultTitle: Pick the folder you want to keep a history for
noVaultBody: Choose a folder in Documents and you can start keeping its changes right here.
othersHint: Not concept documents. They're saved along, but there's nothing to read here.
diffSkippedHint: There are unchanged lines in between
rowSelectHint: Press to see this document's changed lines beside it
stepSelectHint: Press to see this step's exact values
webCopyFailed: Copy failed: the clipboard was blocked
cliPlaceholderHint: Set this once in your terminal: export ATLAS="path to your ontology-atlas source folder". There is no npm package.
remoteFetchHint: Ask the remote where it stands now. This folder is not touched.
remotePullHint: Bring in {behind} step(s) from the remote.
remotePushCommitsFirstHint: {count, plural, one {# change is} other {# changes are}} not saved yet. Pressing opens the save step first; nothing is sent until you confirm.
remoteDoneFirstSend: Sent {branch} to origin. Push and Pull now follow origin/{branch}.
remoteStale: As of the last check. Use Fetch to refresh.
egoAgentReference: Name to use with an AI
egoHint: Point at a neighbour to light it in the drawing · click to move there
egoEmpty: This concept has no links yet
dockNoRemote: Still only on this machine: connect a remote repository to read it elsewhere and keep a backup.
dockNeverSent: origin is connected, but this branch has never been sent there. Send it to read it elsewhere and keep a backup.
dockDetached: Commit {commit} has no branch to send from. Switch to a branch in the terminal (git switch) to send.
pendingHint: {count} file(s) · commit to add to the history
summaryNoUpstream: no remote to send to yet
discardConfirmBody: The uncommitted {added} added and {removed} removed lines in this document go away. They were never committed, so git does not hold them either: this cannot be undone.
discardConfirmDeleted: This deleted document comes back as it was in the last commit.
discardConfirmOthers: Other documents stay as they are. {count} uncommitted change(s) remain.
discardDone: Discarded the changes in {path}. It matches the last commit again.
restoreConfirmBody: Replaces the current content of {path} with its content at this commit ({when}).
restoreConfirmPending: This document has uncommitted changes ({added} added, {removed} removed lines), and those go away too.
restoreConfirmLands: The result stays as an uncommitted change. Read it line by line, and discard it if you change your mind.
restoreConfirmOthers: The other {count} document(s) this commit changed stay as they are.
restoreDone: Restored {path} to this commit's content. It is an uncommitted change now.
restoreDoneOthers: The other {count} document(s) this commit changed stay as they are.
restoreAbsentDeleted: This step deleted the document, so the content to restore is in the steps below
docHistoryTitle: Other steps that changed this document
docHistoryOnly: This is the only step that changed this document
docNotInStep: {path} is not among the files this step lists, so no document is selected here.
docHistoryOlder: Older steps exist too. Show older steps in the list on the left to reach them
docHistoryJumpHint: Press to jump to that step
docReaderPartial: The whole document could not be read; only the changed part is shown
docReaderLong: The document is long, so only the changed part is shown
